feed_title: Waterproof Pillow Dog Bed, Flat No Sides, Green Wipe Clean Outer, Leather Handles, Medium 75 x 55cm and Large 95 x 75cm | PawLunova Wasdale
descriptionHtml:
No sides. Green waterproof outer. Built for a dog who sprawls.

Wasdale is a waterproof pillow dog bed with no raised sides, in Medium 75 × 55 × 10cm and Large 95 × 75 × 12cm. The green outer is the waterproof layer.

Some dogs never curl. They go down on one side, push all four legs out, and finish up with a shoulder on the bed and everything else on the carpet. Give that dog a wall to go round and they spend the first ten minutes shoving it out of the way.

There is nothing round the edge of this one. At 95 × 75cm on the Large, a dog who lies flat out gets the whole footprint to do it on, with no bolster eating into the middle of it.

What they get

  • An open mattress with no walls: Every centimetre of the listed size is sleeping area.
  • Waterproof on the outside: The green outer fabric is the waterproof surface itself, not a liner buried under a cover where you cannot check it.
  • A filled support layer: Cushioning across the whole surface, 10cm deep on the Medium and 12cm on the Large.
  • Leather handles: Lift the empty bed and move it to wherever they have decided to sleep this week.
  • A non-slip base and zip-off covers: It stays put on laminate, and the covers come off for washing.

Best for: dogs who sleep flat out on their side, wet-walk households who want to see the waterproof layer rather than take it on trust, and floors the bed usually slides across.

Why it is worth the money

The Medium is £69 and the Large is £79. Here is where it goes. A green coated outer that is itself the waterproof surface. A filled layer under the whole mattress, 10cm on the Medium and 12cm on the Large. Leather handles on a bed that most owners shift two or three times a week.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

It is flat, and that is the entire point of it. A dog who likes to wedge a chin up on a raised edge will find nothing here to do it against. Those dogs want a bolster instead.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)Suits
Medium75 × 55 × 10Springer Spaniel, Cockapoo, Staffordshire Bull Terrier
Large95 × 75 × 12Golden Retriever, Labrador, German Shepherd

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Because nothing is taken up by sides, the listed figure is the usable figure here. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the outer fabric for everyday marks. Check the sewn-in label before you wash any removable cover, as detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes. Leather handles have their own care instructions where fitted.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
